recipes.title: Bursting Blueberry, Lemon & Walnut Oatmeal
recipes.summary: Creamy rolled oats topped with raw blueberries, bright lemon zest, chopped walnuts, and a light drizzle of honey.
steps: Simmer rolled oats and milk over medium-low heat for 6 to 7 minutes until tender and creamy.
Transfer oats to a warm bowl and fold half of the raw blueberries gently into the surface.
Top with remaining blueberries, chopped walnuts, lemon zest, and a drizzle of honey.
tips: Adding fresh blueberries after cooking keeps their bright pop and raw texture intact.
A tiny pinch of lemon zest wakes up sweet berries without extra sugar.

recipes.title: Fresh Blueberry, Greek Yogurt & Cinnamon Seed Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool thick Greek yogurt heaped with fresh raw blueberries, chia seeds, cinnamon, almond slivers, and honey.
steps: Spoon cold Greek yogurt into a shallow bowl.
Scatter fresh rinsed blueberries, sliced almonds, and chia seeds generously across the top.
Finish with a light dusting of ground cinnamon and a drizzle of honey.
tips: Rinsing blueberries just before serving keeps them plump and crisp.
Lightly crush a few berries with the back of your spoon to swirl purple juice through the yogurt.

recipes.title: Lemon Ricotta & Fresh Blueberry Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp whole-grain toast spread with lemon-scented ricotta and topped with raw blueberries, fresh mint, and cracked black pepper.

ingredient_details.note: lightly pressed so they sit flat

steps: Stir lemon zest into ricotta until light and smooth, then toast the whole-grain bread.
Spread ricotta evenly across the warm toast.
Press fresh blueberries gently into the ricotta so they stay put, and finish with honey and thin mint ribbons.
tips: Lightly pressing berries into the soft ricotta keeps them from rolling off your toast.
Cottage cheese whipped smooth works as an easy high-protein swap for ricotta.

recipes.title: Chilled Blueberry, Vanilla & Almond Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Creamy make-ahead soaked rolled oats layered with fresh raw blueberries, chia seeds, vanilla, cinnamon, and almond milk.
steps: Stir rolled oats, almond milk, chia seeds, vanilla, and cinnamon directly in two jars.
Cover and chill overnight (at least 6 hours) until soft and pudding-like.
Heap fresh raw blueberries on top right before eating.
tips: Soaked overnight oats need zero morning cooking and have a soft, effortless spoon texture.
Add a splash of milk in the morning if you like a looser bowl.

recipes.title: Soft Cottage Cheese & Fresh Blueberry Skillet Cakes
recipes.summary: Tender high-protein oat-and-cottage-cheese griddle cakes studded with sweet blueberries and served with fresh berries on top.
steps: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, rolled oats, and vanilla for 20 seconds until completely smooth.
Brush a nonstick skillet with olive oil over medium-low heat, pour small rounds of batter, and dot with half the blueberries.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until lightly golden and serve topped with the remaining fresh raw blueberries.
tips: Using a blender turns oats and cottage cheese into a velvety batter with zero gritty curds.
Keep the burner at medium-low so the cakes cook evenly inside without scorching.

recipes.title: Baby Spinach, Blueberry, Walnut & Lemon Salad
recipes.summary: Tender baby spinach tossed with juicy raw blueberries, toasted walnuts, creamy avocado, olive oil, lemon, and black pepper.
steps: Whisk olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and cracked black pepper in a large bowl.
Add baby spinach and toss gently until lightly coated.
Scatter fresh raw blueberries, diced avocado, and toasted walnuts over top and serve right away.
tips: Adding blueberries last keeps them plump and prevents them from sinking to the bottom of the bowl.
Crumble a spoonful of goat cheese or feta on top for savory contrast if you enjoy dairy.

recipes.title: Blueberry, Cucumber & Mint Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool fluffy quinoa folded with fresh raw blueberries, crisp cucumber, parsley, mint, lemon juice, olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Fluff cooled quinoa in a bowl with diced cucumber, chopped parsley, and fresh mint.
Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon juice, season with black pepper, and toss evenly.
Gently fold in fresh raw blueberries just before serving.
tips: Make a double batch of plain quinoa on Sunday so weekday bowls take under 10 minutes.
Holds well in the refrigerator for 2 days without turning soggy.

recipes.title: Poached Chicken, Raw Blueberry & Celery Crunch Salad
recipes.summary: Tender shredded chicken tossed in lemon-yogurt dressing with crisp celery stalk, sweet raw blueberries, and black pepper.
steps: Stir Greek yogurt, lemon juice, chopped parsley, and cracked black pepper together in a mixing bowl.
Fold in tender shredded chicken and finely diced celery stalk until evenly coated.
Gently fold in fresh raw blueberries and serve over greens or tucked into soft whole-grain bread.
tips: Fresh blueberries give the exact sweet-tart pop of classic grapes in chicken salad with zero slicing required.
Use rotisserie or pre-poached chicken to keep this a zero-heat lunch.

recipes.title: Chickpea, Blueberry & Lemon-Herb Greens Bowl
recipes.summary: Hearty no-cook salad combining creamy chickpeas, fresh raw blueberries, crisp cucumber, olive oil, lemon, and fresh basil.
steps: Rinse and drain chickpeas well, then place in a bowl with diced cucumber and torn fresh basil.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and cracked black pepper and toss over the chickpea mixture.
Fold in fresh raw blueberries gently and serve chilled or at room temperature.
tips: Patting chickpeas dry on a clean towel helps the lemon-olive oil dressing cling better.
Fresh basil and sweet blueberries pair beautifully with crisp cucumber.

recipes.title: Avocado, Crushed Blueberry & Basil Open-Faced Toast
recipes.summary: Savory-sweet toasted tartine with mashed avocado, fresh raw blueberries, torn basil, lemon juice, olive oil, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Mash ripe avocado with fresh lemon juice and spread generously on toasted whole-grain bread.
Arrange fresh raw blueberries over the avocado, pressing lightly so they stay nestled.
Top with torn basil, a light drizzle of olive oil, and freshly cracked black pepper.
tips: Freshly cracked black pepper bridges sweet blueberries and creamy avocado.
Add a poached egg on top for a more substantial midday meal.

recipes.title: Gentle Baked Salmon with Fresh Blueberry-Lime Relish
recipes.summary: Flaky oven-baked salmon fillets crowned with a vibrant raw relish of blueberries, cucumber, red onion, mint, and fresh lime.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Brush salmon fillets with olive oil, season with black pepper, and bake 12 to 14 minutes until flaky.
While salmon bakes, combine roughly chopped raw blueberries, finely diced cucumber, minced red onion, mint, and lime juice.
Transfer warm salmon to plates and spoon the cool blueberry-lime relish generously over top.
tips: Roughly chopping half the berries releases bright juice that acts as an instant natural sauce for rich salmon.
Serve alongside steamed rice or tender baby spinach.

recipes.title: Skillet Chicken with Warm Blueberry-Thyme Pan Sauce
recipes.summary: Golden seared chicken cutlets glazed in a quick savory pan sauce of sweet onion, fresh thyme, lemon, black pepper, and blueberries.

ingredient_details.note: half simmered, half stirred in raw at the end

steps: Season chicken cutlets with black pepper and sear in olive oil 4 minutes per side until cooked through; transfer to a warm plate.
Saute diced onion, garlic, and thyme in the same skillet for 2 minutes, then add half the blueberries, lemon juice, and 1/3 cup water.
Simmer 3 minutes until berries soften into a glossy glaze, turn off heat, stir in remaining raw blueberries, and spoon over chicken.
tips: Stirring in half the berries off the heat preserves fresh pops of raw fruit inside the warm savory glaze.
Pairs well with mashed sweet potato or soft polenta.

recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potato, Spinach & Blueberry Harvest Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm roasted sweet potato and chickpeas layered over tender spinach with fresh raw blueberries, walnuts, lemon, and olive oil.
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss cubed sweet potato and chickpeas with 1 tablespoon olive oil and black pepper on a lined sheet pan.
Roast 20 to 22 minutes until sweet potatoes are fork-tender and golden.
Pile warm sweet potato and chickpeas over baby spinach, drizzle with remaining olive oil and lemon juice, and top with raw blueberries and walnuts.
tips: The warm sweet potatoes gently wilt the spinach right in the bowl with zero extra pans.
Pre-cubed sweet potatoes make this an easy one-sheet dinner.

recipes.title: Herb-Seared Tofu over Warm Barley & Raw Blueberry Greens
recipes.summary: Golden garlic-thyme tofu resting on warm cooked barley and tender greens tossed with raw blueberries, olive oil, and lemon.

ingredient_details.note: sliced into slabs and patted dry

steps: Sear dried tofu slabs in 1 tablespoon olive oil with minced garlic and black pepper for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Toss warm cooked barley and baby spinach with remaining olive oil and fresh lemon juice.
Top bowls with warm golden tofu and scatter fresh raw blueberries over everything.
tips: Pressing tofu briefly in a clean towel helps it brown evenly without sticking.
Cooked farro or brown rice works seamlessly if you do not have barley on hand.

recipes.title: Lemon-Baked Cod with Shaved Celery & Blueberry Salsa
recipes.summary: Mild flaky baked cod brightened with a cool raw topping of blueberries, thinly shaved celery stalk, parsley, lemon, and olive oil.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Drizzle cod fillets with half the olive oil and black pepper and bake 12 to 14 minutes until flaky.
Toss halved raw blueberries, thinly shaved celery stalk, parsley, remaining olive oil, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Spoon the cool blueberry-celery topping over the hot flaky cod right before serving.
tips: Mild white cod lets delicate fresh blueberries and herbs shine cleanly.
Serve with warm boiled potatoes or quinoa to round out the plate.

recipes.title: Creamy Raw Blueberry, Greek Yogurt & Honey Smoothie
recipes.summary: Thick, velvety purple smoothie blending raw blueberries, plain Greek yogurt, a squeeze of lemon, honey, and chilled milk.
steps: Combine chilled milk, Greek yogurt, fresh raw blueberries, lemon juice, and honey in a blender.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until deeply purple and silky smooth.
Pour over a few ice cubes if you want it extra frosty.
tips: A teaspoon of lemon juice intensifies the natural berry flavor.
Add 2 tablespoons rolled oats if you want a more filling breakfast smoothie.

recipes.title: Silky Blueberry, Avocado & Baby Spinach Smoothie
recipes.summary: Lush, spoon-smooth berry blend combining raw blueberries, ripe avocado, baby spinach, cinnamon, and chilled almond milk.
steps: Place almond milk and baby spinach in the blender first and pulse until smooth.
Add raw blueberries, avocado, and ground cinnamon.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until velvety and rich.
tips: Avocado creates a lush, milkshake-like consistency with healthy fats and zero banana flavor.
Thin with a splash of cold water if desired.

recipes.title: Fresh Blueberry, Ripe Pear & Ginger Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright, naturally sweet smoothie blending raw blueberries, juicy ripe pear, fresh grated ginger, lime, and chilled water.
steps: Core and roughly chop the ripe pear.
Add cold water, raw blueberries, pear, grated ginger, and lime juice to the blender.
Blend on high until completely smooth and frosty.
tips: Ripe pear adds gentle natural sweetness and fiber without masking the fresh blueberry aroma.
Use a handful of ice cubes for a colder afternoon sip.

recipes.title: Blueberry, Dark Cocoa & Walnut Butter Smoothie
recipes.summary: Deep chocolate-berry smoothie blending raw blueberries, walnuts, unsweetened cocoa, rolled oats, and oat milk.
steps: Add milk, walnuts, rolled oats, and cocoa powder to the blender first.
Add fresh raw blueberries and blend on high for 60 seconds until completely velvety.
Pour chilled and enjoy immediately.
tips: Blending the walnuts and oats thoroughly gives a naturally nutty, silky finish.
Add half a pitted date or a teaspoon of honey if you like it sweeter.

recipes.title: Blueberry, Banana & Mint Cooling Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing purple blend of raw blueberries, half a ripe banana, fresh mint leaves, lemon juice, and chilled coconut water.
steps: Place chilled coconut water, raw blueberries, banana, fresh mint leaves, and lemon juice into a blender.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until completely smooth.
Serve cold over ice.
tips: A few leaves of fresh mint give a crisp, garden-fresh aroma without overpowering the berries.
Use a frozen banana half if you prefer a thicker frostier glass.

recipes.title: Fresh Blueberry, Lemon & Mint Agua Fresca
recipes.summary: Jewel-toned strained blueberry juice brightened with fresh lemon, cooling mint leaves, and chilled water.
steps: Blend fresh raw blueberries, lemon juice, mint leaves, honey, and cold water for 40 seconds.
Pour through a fine-mesh strainer, pressing the berry pulp gently with a spoon.
Serve chilled over ice garnished with a mint leaf.
tips: Blending and straining extracts much more vibrant juice from blueberries than most centrifugal juicers.
Save the strained berry pulp to stir into morning oatmeal or yogurt.

recipes.title: Ruby Blueberry, Crisp Apple & Ginger Press
recipes.summary: Crisp freshly pressed apple and ginger juice swirled with pureed raw blueberries and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Juice the quartered apples and ginger together (or blend everything with cold water).
Blend the fresh raw blueberries into the apple-ginger juice with fresh lemon juice, then strain smooth.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Sweet Honeycrisp or Gala apples balance tangy ginger naturally.
Chilling your produce beforehand means you do not need ice that dilutes the juice.

recipes.title: Cooling Blueberry, Cucumber & Lime Juice
recipes.summary: Ultra-hydrating violet-tinted cooler combining crisp cucumber, fresh raw blueberries, bright lime, and cold coconut water.
steps: Blend peeled cucumber slices, fresh raw blueberries, lime juice, and chilled coconut water until completely liquid.
Strain through a fine mesh into a pitcher, pressing lightly.
Serve cold over ice.
tips: Peeling the cucumber gives a cleaner, milder finish and vibrant berry color.
Excellent light hydration on warm afternoons.

recipes.title: Crisp Blueberry, Celery Stalk & Lemon Tonic
recipes.summary: Freshly pressed celery stalk and lemon juice softened with sweet raw blueberries for a crisp, mineral-rich glass.
steps: Combine chopped celery stalk, cored apple, raw blueberries, lemon juice, and cold water in a blender.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until completely liquefied.
Strain smoothly through a fine mesh and serve chilled.
tips: Sweet blueberries mellow celery's grassy note for an easy-to-drink green-purple tonic.
Drink fresh for the brightest flavor.

recipes.title: Sweet Orange, Blueberry & Fresh Basil Cooler
recipes.summary: Fresh-squeezed orange juice blended with raw blueberries, aromatic sweet basil leaves, and chilled sparkling or still water.
steps: Juice the fresh oranges into a blender and add raw blueberries and sweet basil leaves.
Blend 30 seconds until smooth, then strain into two ice-filled glasses.
Top with cold still or sparkling water and stir gently.
tips: Fresh basil lends a subtle peppery sweetness that pairs naturally with citrus and berries.
Using plain seltzer turns this into a refreshing alcohol-free dinner spritz.
